title: Replacing the PII information in original log file and a temporary file
body:
**Description**:
Temp file of the already converted file should be provided in a meaningful manner (anon-1520948971627-anon-1520946792014-audit.log).

**Affected Product Version**:
EI 6.1.1 update 23

**OS, DB, other environment details and versions**:
OS - ubuntu 15.10
DB - mysql 5.6
JDK - 1.8

**Pre- Requisites**
PII information exists in the logs for user Peter and Sam

**Steps to recreate the issue**
1. Execute the tool to replace the user information (ex: ./forget-me.sh -U peter)
2. Stop the server and remove the original log file
3. Start the server and perform the operation
4. Execute the tool to replace information (ex: ./forget-me.sh -U Sam) in the original log file (audit.log) and the previous temp file (anon-1520946792014-audit.log)

**Observations**
temp files are getting generated for the original log and the initial temp file. How can we manage to replace PII information when original log file and temporary log file contains PII information.

![screenshot from 2018-03-13 19-50-26](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14962228/37347438-d84a4b84-26f7-11e8-9999-9abe3a8dd884.png)

**Related**
[1] https://github.com/wso2/identity-anonymization-tool/issues/60
